accepted.title: Supply 12 V rail overloaded in the stall mode
accepted.reason: Known gap of the stock SO-101 power supply: the README's 12 V 5 A supply (60 W) cannot hold all six STS3215 servos at stall (6 x 2.7 A x 12 V). Builders report brown-outs and servo resets under heavy load (issue #132); ordinary moves fit (no-load budget 14.4 W). For heavy work, use a bigger supply (README: '12V 5A+').
